q1a.label: Can the image support a judgement on this question?
q1a.help: Judge image quality and view. Choose Yes if the image clearly shows the target is absent. With Partly, judge what is visible. No ends the record.

q1b.label: Is the question–answer pair itself valid?
q1b.help: Tick all that apply. Continue the review even if the QA pair is invalid.

options.unanswerable: Question cannot be answered from the image and the information in the question
options.off_topic: Answer does not address the question

q2.label: Does the answer report a finding that is not in the image, or miss an important finding that is?
q2.help: Tick all that apply. Count omissions within the scope of the question.

q3.label: For findings that are present, is any of these wrong?
q3.help: Tick all that apply. Use BI-RADS or TI-RADS where appropriate. Explain any Other selection in the case note.

q4.label: Does the answer state something that neither the image nor the question supports?
q4.help: Tick all that apply and quote the words. Information supplied in the question counts as evidence.

options.E7: More certain than the evidence allows (E7)

q5.label: If there is any error, is it likely to be clinically significant?
q5.help: Choose Likely to be significant if the error is likely to change interpretation, management or triage. Use Not applicable (phantom) only for phantom images.

q6.label: Do the question, the answer text and the mask point to the same target?
q6.help: Check whether they refer to the same target. Pixel-level assessment of the outline is unnecessary.
